title: Evaluation of a lifted clause
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be natural numbers with $a\le K$. Take a clause on $r+a$ sign coordinates whose literals use pairwise distinct coordinates, and an assignment of signs to $r+K$ coordinates. The lifted clause evaluates to $-1$ on that assignment if and only if the original clause evaluates to $-1$ on the assignment restricted along the coordinate embedding from $r+a$ coordinates into $r+K$.
hypotheses_covered: The clause is a DNFTerm on $r+a$ coordinates, with pairwise distinct literal indices
The assignment is a sign assignment on $r+K$ coordinates
